title: Diene Helm Wrapper Values
description: Generated schema for the diene Helm wrapper sample.

contracts.description: Current health and webhook delivery conventions.

fullnameOverride.description: Primary workload fullname. It must be `<service>-<dashless-token>`.

gateway.description: Provider-managed LoadBalancer service for the gateway.

global.description: Chart-wide values. Helm propagates this table verbatim into every pinned dependency, so it is the only lever a wrapper decision has over an upstream object.

labelPrefix.description: Prefix used by every service-tree label and annotation key, wrapper-owned and upstream alike. It must be one DNS-1123 subdomain.

instance.description: Optional physical-instance metadata. The instance remains outside LPSM and is never minted here.

original.description: Recorded physical instance segment for every non-preview landscape. It must already be one DNS-1123 label; the chart never lowercases, truncates, or hashes it.

preview.description: castform preview identity. The chart consumes authorized-assembler output only; it never mints, canonicalizes, or suffixes a petname.

canonical.description: The typed CanonicalPreviewInstance handed to this chart. It must bind byte-for-byte to the receipt below.

enabled.description: Render the receipt-bound preview coordinate. Every field below is refused unless it is internally consistent.

manifest.description: The fully resolved manifest the receipt was minted from. Unresolved branch pins refuse; they are resolved to commits at mint.

branchResolutions.description: Branch pins recorded with the commit they resolved to at mint. The commit must equal the pin, so a moving branch cannot move the rendered hostname.

pins.description: One pin per `<platform>.<service>`. Values are a released version, a full commit, or `{kind: operator, version: <v>}`.

receipt.description: The broker-verified assembler receipt. `fullLeaseDigest` and `leaseKey` stay internal and are never rendered into an object or a hostname.

collision.description: Live base-petname collision recorded at mint. A digest here is the DIFFERENT live digest that forced the three-character suffix.

migration.description: Separate pre-sync migration hook. It never owns or recreates the Deployment.

primordial.description: Reusable primordial-chart CR helper inputs against the frozen T3 shapes.

secret.description: One service-scoped ExternalSecret with folder-prefix rewrites.

serviceTree.description: Stable four-slot service-tree projection. Landscape and cluster are added by independent overlays.

upstream.description: Pinned upstream chart, instantiated by every committed stack. Every instantiated dependency must receive a conforming override.

controllers.description: Exactly one controller, so the rendered Deployment keeps the unsuffixed `wrapper-upstream` name.

annotations.description: Reloader opts in on the Deployment metadata, matching every wrapper-owned workload.

strategy.description: The upstream workload rolls like every wrapper-owned Deployment; it is never recreated.

enabled.description: Render the pinned upstream dependency. It is instantiated by every committed stack.

fullnameOverride.description: Explicit conforming `<service>-<token>` name. Every rendered upstream object is named exactly this.

global.description: Chart-wide upstream settings. `global` is the only lever that reaches every rendered upstream object.

annotations.description: Service-tree annotations stamped on every upstream object. Keys are templated on the same `global.labelPrefix` as the labels above.

createDefaultServiceAccount.description: No upstream-owned ServiceAccount: the dependency must not mint resource names the wrapper did not authorize.

labels.description: Service-tree labels stamped on every upstream object. Keys are Helm templates rendered against the dependency context, so `global.labelPrefix` reaches an upstream key exactly as it reaches a wrapper-owned one.

service.description: Exactly one ClusterIP Service, so the rendered Service keeps the unsuffixed `wrapper-upstream` name.

webhookRoute.description: Optional Gateway API route scaffold for a webhook receiver.
